basic_profile.bio: A culinary enthusiast and gamer based in the Midwest. By day, I work as a software developer, but my true passion lies in cooking. I enjoy recreating in-game recipes and sharing them with my online friends. I'm currently single and spend my evenings and weekends gaming or experimenting with new dishes. I usually log onto Reddit after work and late into the night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having studied it in college and now working in the field. My cooking skills are self-taught, developed through years of experimenting in the kitchen and watching countless cooking shows and YouTube tutorials.
